items.title: Lower bound for the tau-matching chromatic number via the alternation number
items.author: Saeed Shaebani; Meysam Alishahi
items.work: The Matching Ramsey Number of Hypergraphs, Revisited
items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is Theorem mainthmSaeed at source lines 168-176: for a tau-admissible hypergraph H it must produce a finite B with sum of tau over B at least |V(H)|-alt_r(H) and must bound chi_M(tau,H) by the minimum size of a finite A with sum of tau over A at least |V(H)|-alt_r(H). Its proof at source lines 194-230 is not adjacent to the statement: the author's remark at 178-186 and the pointer sentence at 192 sit in between, and the proof itself opens with the bold header Proof of Theorem mainthmSaeed at line 194. The argument augments H by r-1-tau(a) singleton-edged dummy vertices for every a in A (lines 197-204) and then has to show two things that are not routine: first that the extended colouring is a proper vertex colouring of the general Kneser hypergraph of the augmented hypergraph (lines 205-212), and second that the two quantities used in the count, (r-1)|A| = sum of tau over A + |V(H~)|-|V(H)| and alt_r(H~) = alt_r(H), both hold after the augmentation (line 218); the second identity is the delicate point, because the added singleton edges must not increase the alternation number. The deep topological input is the cited Alishahi-Hajiabolhassan bound restated at source lines 159-162 and is not re-proved here, so the counted material is rated H2 rather than H3.
